name: GoodtoGive
shortDescription: UK giving, Gift Aid-management and charity-support platform with church-focused mobile-app options.

pricing.summary: GoodtoGive's published charity terms say there is no monthly subscription fee for charities using the service, but a 3.2% GoodtoGive processing fee and payment-processing fee are deducted from each donation and reclaimed Gift Aid. Separate product terms may apply to accounting, GDPR and mobile-app services.

tiers.detail: Published terms say fees are deducted per donation and reclaimed Gift Aid; separate service terms can apply

pricing.trialDetails: No general product trial was found in the public material reviewed.

gdprInformation: GoodtoGive publishes privacy material and terms that describe charity data-processing roles. Its terms also refer to separate product-specific terms, so a church should obtain the documents that apply to the exact service it intends to use.
coreFeatures: Financial controls and accounting support services

hmrc-claiming.value: Good to Give Limited is included in HMRC's current commercial-supplier list for GoodtoGive Gift Aid Maximisation.

fees.value: Published charity terms describe no monthly subscription fee, a 3.2% GoodtoGive processing fee, and payment-processing fees.

data-processing.value: Published terms describe GoodtoGive as processor for personal information processed on a charity's behalf and link to privacy information.

editorial.assessment: GoodtoGive combines online giving and Gift Aid claim services with broader charity support and a church-app offering. It is most relevant where a church wants a managed, fee-based donation and Gift Aid workflow rather than a standalone donor database. The terms describe payment and claim flows in detail; a church should map these against its own finance controls before changing provider.
